name: Flux 1.1 Pro
description: State-of-the-art image generation with exceptional prompt adherence.
longDescription: Flux 1.1 Pro is the flagship image generation model from Black Forest Labs (founded by the creators of Stable Diffusion). It achieves state-of-the-art image quality with exceptional prompt adherence, photorealistic output, and superior handling of text, hands, and complex compositions.
limitations: Proprietary API only for Pro version

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://api.bfl.ml/v1/flux-pro-1.1",
    headers={"X-Key": "$BFL_API_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    json={"prompt": "A serene mountain landscape at dawn", "width": 1024, "height": 1024}
)
result = response.json()
print(result["id"])
